```yaml
name: Auto-regenerate cargo-vet exemptions

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  regenerate-exemptions:
    name: Regenerate cargo-vet exemptions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Install cargo-vet
        run: cargo install cargo-vet

      - name: Check if exemptions need regeneration
        id: check-exemptions
        run: |
          # Check if cargo-vet is configured
          if [ ! -f "Cargo-vet.toml" ]; then
            echo "No Cargo-vet.toml found, skipping."
            echo "skip=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          # Try to regenerate exemptions
          # This command updates the exemptions file based on current dependencies
          cargo vet regenerate exemptions
          
          # Check if the exemptions file was modified
          if git diff --quiet Cargo-vet.toml; then
            echo "No changes to exemptions."
            echo "skip=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Exemptions updated."
            echo "skip=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push updated exemptions
        if: steps.check-exemptions.outputs.skip == 'false'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          git add Cargo-vet.toml
          git commit -m "chore: auto-regenerate cargo-vet exemptions for Dependabot PR"
          git push
```
